title: ornus americana
intro: Ornus americana, commonly known as American White Dogwood, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to Eastern North America. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, lower blood pressure, and alleviate symptoms of fever and rheumatism. The therapeutic actions of Ornus americana include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and astringent properties, which contribute to its use in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
